prior_review.content_utf8:
# Resumefolio — Model Consistency, Traceability and Review

Owner: Farhad Valizadegan. Activity SA-RV01 / RV-D07; November 1, 2026. Reviewer: Codex documentary/structural review; no stakeholder acceptance or product execution.

## 1. Continuation Verdict and Limits

**Partial: sufficient inputs for provisional System Analysis continuation, not acceptance of the Requirements Engineering or analysis baseline.** Accepted scope, source ownership, proposed requirements, scenarios and definitions support context/domain modeling. Open decisions must remain attached to affected relationships/transitions. OAuth and backup setup absence do not prevent modeling required responsibilities; actual access/suitability still blocks the existing dependent gates.

Target: current Project Planning, Requirements Engineering inputs and existing System Analysis. Baseline: accepted scope/constraints and existing phase criteria, not an assumed approved interpretation of every detailed proposal. Input hashes and the uncommitted working-copy boundary are recorded in [evidence](evidence/context-input-review-2026-11-01.json).

## 2. Checks Performed and Result

| Check / risk | Observed evidence | Result and practical limit |
|---|---|---|
| Local file/section references | Automated pre-edit scan: 4,118 references resolved; no missing local file/fragment found | Structural Pass for that scan; says nothing about external service availability |
| Candidate identity | 157 unique candidate headings; no duplicate IDs | Pass for identifier integrity; final convention/priority acceptance still pending |
| Proposed detailed criteria/cases | Existing inventory has 470 unique proposed criterion locators, 28 answer groups, 84 planned RC cases; 22 Answer proposed and 6 Under investigation | Structural availability; not 470 verified criteria or 84 executed tests |
| Whole-product scope | All twelve SCP catalog areas associated with the current primary specification families and context responsibility rows | Pass for presence/boundary inventory; per-criterion semantic sufficiency still Partial |
| External boundary coverage | IF-01–IF-08 represented in context table with exact primary references | Source-derived context draft, not an API/schema/deployment selection |
| Access separation | Actor catalog, ACC/PDF/PRP/EGC/GIT/YML obligations compared with context roles/exchanges | Scope-level separation retained; detailed matrices/transitions still require review/modeling |
| PDF scenario consistency | UC-D02 configuration saving remains independent from the separately triggered disable-link path | Specific earlier mismatch remains corrected; session-policy proposal is not silently accepted |
| Source/tailoring/history | Independent resume overrides, current live/PDF representations and actual submitted copies remain distinct in context | Boundary retained; complete domain/data/state contracts remain work |
| Knowledge versus unknowns | Owner answers: 20 hours/week; OAuth not created; backups not set up | Known inputs, not evidence of future capacity/access/recovery |
| Repository revision | HEAD 4ce9d39; modified current planning/tracking files, untracked requirements/analysis and sizing file observed | No exact committed new baseline exists; identify this working candidate by source hashes |
| Analysis readiness | Prior context/purpose/review files were scaffolds; domain model was partial | Addressed this revision for purpose/context and bounded review only; remaining views still incomplete |

## 3. Material Findings and Gates

| Finding / confidence | Impact | Reference / minimum action |
|---|---|---|
| High, confirmed: detailed policies/targets are proposals, not owner disposition | Blocks accepting affected requirements/design as settled | Q-D records / RBC-D04–D07 / RF-D03/RF-D05; analyze explicitly as draft and record actual decisions later |
| High, confirmed: criterion-to-path/model sufficiency not exhausted | Blocks claiming complete requirement/model coverage | RF-D01/RF-D02; develop exact semantic links and normal/denied/failure/concurrency cases |
| High, confirmed: runtime/setup observations do not verify combined capacity, OAuth, safe execution or recovery | Blocks dependent capability/design/release acceptance at its gate | Existing ASM/DEP/GAP-D records; retain bounded feasibility work; no new gate waiver |
| Medium, confirmed: most analysis views are still scaffolds | Blocks completed System Analysis/design handoff | Populate core class/data/interaction/state/activity/rule/contract views with sources; do not count a context diagram as their completion |
| Medium, confirmed: current candidate is uncommitted | Cannot attribute this analysis to an accepted Git baseline | Use recorded hashes for this review; future commit preserves work but does not supply owner acceptance |

These are dispositions of existing known issues and this bounded analysis-readiness review, not a competing question/decision register. Primary requirements, [shared findings](../02-requirements-engineering/06-validation-and-traceability/review-plan-and-findings.md) and [questions](../02-requirements-engineering/07-change-and-baseline/open-questions-and-decisions.md) retain authority. No RF or Q-D parent is closed by this review.

## 4. Context Trace Examples

| Exact source / criterion | Analysis element | Related existing path | Open matter / evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| ACC-D04-AC01 | Private actor/resource boundary, context section 2 | UC-D01/UC-D03 contexts and denied variants; RC-Q04/RC-Q05 proposed checks | Q-D04/Q-D05; no product execution |
| PDF-D03-AC01, PDF-D06-AC01/AC02 | Mode versus link-control boundary, sections 3–4 | UC-D02 configuration and independent link-disable path | Q-D10/Q-D11; no automatic coupling |
| PRP-D03-AC01 | Source/override independence, section 4 and partial domain model | UC-D01; RC-Q06/RC-Q07 | Q-D06/Q-D07; proposed detailed update mechanism |
| APP-D06-AC01 | Actual submitted-material history, SCP-06 and section 4 | UC-D05; RC-Q13/RC-Q14 | Q-D13/Q-D14; capture/retention/restore acceptance pending |
| GIT-D03-AC01 | External real-client interaction IF-06 | UC-D09-CLONE / UC-D09-PUSH; RC-Q21 | Q-D21; no actual client/engine verification |
| YML-D04-AC01, YML-D10-AC01 | Conditional execution responsibility and separately approved target IF-07 | UC-D10; RC-Q23 | Q-D23 / GAP-D09; no runner selection or enabled execution |

Paths are [existing scenario locators](../02-requirements-engineering/04-scenarios-and-models/user-stories-and-scenarios.md). This table supplies specific analysis associations, not exhaustive or executed criterion coverage. Check a path's actual steps/inputs/results before claiming it verifies a criterion.

## 5. Cross-View Completion Checklist

- [x] Record current input review, limits and continuation disposition.
- [x] Populate full logical context, scope/actor/interface inventory and two editable/rendered diagrams.
- [ ] Complete source-linked domain classes, relationships and justified multiplicities.
- [ ] Align conceptual data and function/data-flow views.
- [ ] Align interactions, operations, activities, rules and state transitions.
- [ ] Model denied, failed, partial/unknown, concurrent and recovery outcomes where relevant.
- [ ] Exhaust exact criterion-level semantic mapping and recheck existing findings.
- [ ] Record actual owner decision on an identified analysis/design-handoff candidate.

## 6. Next Coherent Work

Continue the core professional presentation domain/data and operation/state analysis. Use existing Q-D06–Q-D14 proposals as explicitly provisional input; do not ask the owner to restate already documented workflows. Capture conflicts or true gaps in primary records. Keep provider/runner/backup/forecast investigations running at the gates that depend on them. Product implementation and accepted design handoff remain later work.
